properties.evidence: BL-155 states plainly that it 'cannot tell unused from unreachable', and lists three explanations it has no way to separate. Hand-rolled work discriminates between them directly: a session that wrote a script to do X proves someone wanted X badly enough to build it, which absence-of-a-call can never show. This is the instrument that would resolve BL-155's stated ambiguity rather than restate it.
